title: Janus Infinite Faces — Emergency Autonomy Without Quorum Test

bad_extremes.total_paralysis: Reject all actions because quorum is unavailable, allowing preventable local harm.
bad_extremes.emergency_sovereignty: Treat any declared emergency as permission to regain unrestricted global authority.

capability_constraints: action class must be predeclared before the emergency where feasible
action must address an immediate local safety condition
scope must be limited to locally controlled resource or actuator
action must not create new external host obligations
action must not transfer shared exclusive assets
action must not weaken fencing for later global commands
local receipt must be retained and reconciled after connectivity returns

emergency_escalation_guard.reason: Otherwise any face or isolated replica could bypass quorum by labeling its preferred action an emergency.

causal_model: NO_QUORUM -> GLOBAL_WRITE_BLOCKED + PREAUTHORIZED_LOCAL_FAILSAFE -> LOCAL_SAFETY_EFFECT -> PENDING_RECEIPT -> LATER_RECONCILIATION

ru: Рука может отдёрнуться от огня, не получая права владеть всем миром.
Отсутствие quorum запрещает общий commit, но не обязано запрещать заранее ограниченное локальное спасение.
Emergency — это сужение действия до необходимого, а не расширение власти до бесконечности.
en: A hand may pull away from fire without gaining authority over the whole world.
No quorum blocks shared commit but need not block pre-authorized local safety.
Emergency narrows action to necessity; it does not expand authority to infinity.
